blueprint.name: Larch House — Luxury Log Cabin
blueprint.author: Jerome
blueprint.desc: 18 x 15 m primitive-only log lodge. Three upper bedrooms, open mezzanine, L stair and full-height stone fireplace. Ridge 9.8 m; approved 22.9-degree gable. Structural collision including roof; five animated server-authoritative hinged doors; four interior sconces and ten exterior spots. Requires Hyperfy native extrude.
